name: dsh-system-monitor
description: System monitor plugin for the dsh web GUI: a right-sidebar "System" panel with live CPU (per-core + frequency), memory/swap, GPU (utilization, VRAM, temperature, power, processes) and temperature/fan/power telemetry. Host half samples /proc, /sys/class/hwmon and nvidia-smi and serves one loopback-only JSON route; client half renders the panel and sparklines.
